page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-16-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, aligning it with memory-intensive workload requirements. The instance operates on dedicated CPU allocation without hardware GPU acceleration or local storage.

The arm64 architecture offers a power-efficient alternative to traditional x86 platforms, translating to qualitative cost efficiencies for deployments requiring high memory density. By providing 128.0 GB of RAM alongside 16 dedicated vCPUs, this instance family optimizes resource allocation for workloads that are constrained by memory capacity rather than raw compute cycles or storage I/O.

This server type is configured for memory-optimized applications, including in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications. The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators makes it suitable for stateless memory-intensive processing or architectures utilizing external cloud storage solutions.
